page.overview:
Who is Masseuse Bug?

The Masseuse Bug is a minor character in A Bug's Life.

"Ahh... lower, lower. While the grasshopper gang relax at their desert "resort," Hopper enjoys a relaxing massage. But just as he is getting the kinks worked out of his exoskeleton, Molt appears. Now Hopper's nerves are in knots again."
